MARCH, 2013 TO ALL TO WHOM THESE PRESENTS shall come. GREETINGS: WHEREAS by Clause ( 1 ) of Article 52 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, it is provided that unless otherwise directed by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, there shall be a session of the Legislative Council once at least in every year, SO that a period of more than 12 months shall not intervene between the last sitting in one session and the date appointed fo r its first sitting in the next sesslon. AND WHEREAS by Clause ( 2 ) of Article 52 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, it is provided that each session of the Legislative Council shall be held at such place and shall commence and end at such time as His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may from time to time, by notice published in the Gazette, appoint · N OW THEREFORE WE in exercise of the powers conferred upon US by the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam do hereby appoint the 24th. day of RabiuIakhir, the Hijrah of Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of Allah) one thousand, four hundred and thirty-four corresponding to the 7th. d ay of March tw o thousand and thirteen, to be the date for the commencement of a session of the Legislative Council to be held at the Dewan Persidangan Majlis Mesyuarat Negara, Dewan Majlisf Jalan Dewan Majlis, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam at 9 · oo ofclock in the forenoon. Done at OUR lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam this IOth. d ay of RabiuIakhir, the Hijriah of Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousandf four hundred and thirty-four corresponding to the 21st. d ay of FebruarYI two thousand and thirteen, being the forty-sixth year of OUR Reign in Brunei Darussalam. 71
